# raw/external/precedents/

Research notes on products that established patterns ECHO builds on.

## What goes here

Each precedent gets one markdown file capturing:
- What they do
- Pattern they established
- Lessons applicable to ECHO
- Specific product decisions that map (or differ)

## Suggested precedents to research

- **Wispr Flow** — Fn-key + keyboard injection pattern → applied to context delivery
- **Grammarly** — DOM-overlay across all input fields → user-side ingestion model
- **1Password** — read/write across any login form → universal extension precedent
- **Honey / Rakuten** — DOM observer at checkout → user-side ingestion at moment of intent
- **Plaid** — connectivity layer between banks and apps → "layer above" structural position
- **Cursor** — narrow audience + deep integration → V1 wedge discipline
- **Raycast** — system-wide hotkey + composer → ambient form factor
- **Notion AI** — built-in transcription → compose-don't-capture exemplar
- **Granola / Otter / Fathom** — meeting transcript tools → V1.5 transcript ingestion source
- **Stripe** — API not dashboard → infrastructure positioning
- **Reddit Enhancement Suite** — survived API shutdown → user-side > API-based
- **Adblockers** — DOM rewriting at scale → existence proof for user-side architecture

## Pattern

Filename = product name in kebab-case: `wispr-flow.md`, `cursor.md`, `plaid.md`
